intended_application: Draft internal help-desk replies with mandatory human review
business_need: Reduce drafting time without reducing reply accuracy
users_stakeholders: Help-desk staff, managers, IT and employees
capabilities_constraints: Synthetic evidence only. All eight areas have pilot demonstrations; no production-scale evidence.
risk_consequence_context: Internal low-consequence requests only; exclude sensitive data and access changes.
management_question: Is this organization ready for a four-week, ten-user pilot?
additional_context: Synthetic exercise. Assume dated pilot evidence for signed sponsor charter; observed staff assessments; SOP and fallback drill; approved sandbox and data checks; four-week staffing and support budget; risk approvals and stop authority; representative user feedback and communication; accepted service RACI and incident/exit drill. Proposed stop: any sensitive-data disclosure; proposed success: 20% drafting-time reduction with no accuracy degradation. These assumptions must be verified before a real decision.
